text.tspan: Cumulative CO₂ emissions released by wildfires in 2026World
Carbon dioxide emissions from wildfires are measured in tonnes per week. Average is the mean CO₂ emissions
over the period from 2012 to 2024. Maximum and minimum are the highest and lowest years.
Data source: Global Wildfire Information System (2026)
